steps.note: Start the single-stage event creation flow.
Ensure the test company supports multi-currency exchange rates before creating the event.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Set the required delivery location for the first line item.
Invite a QA test vendor so the event can receive a bid.
Confirm the event is live on a real project page.
Place a vendor bid so exchange rates should become locked.
Confirm the bid was accepted before attempting the rate change.

args.goal: On the buyer-side live multi-currency RFQ with a bid already placed, open the exchange-rate editor, attempt to change the exchange rate, and stop when the product shows the refusal for changing rates after bids.

steps.note: No catalog step directly edits exchange rates, so perform the buyer-side rate-change attempt while preserving the post-bid state.

args.text: Exchange rates cannot be updated after bids have been placed.

steps.note: Assert the exact refusal message required by the case.
